cases.translation: I saw the Lord standing at the altar.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at, by) governs the dative case in the meaning of proximity or location.

cases.sentence: Бей по верхушкам колонн, пусть задрожит ___, обруши их на головы им всем.
cases.translation: Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake.
cases.explain: The threshold is the subject of the imperative verb задрожит (may tremble), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть зароются хоть в мир ___, и оттуда достанет их моя рука.
cases.translation: Though they dig into the world of the dead, from there my hand will take them.
cases.explain: The noun 'мир мертвых' (world of the dead) uses the genitive мертвых to modify 'мир.'

cases.sentence: Пусть взберутся на небеса, и оттуда я свергну ___.
cases.translation: Though they climb up to heaven, from there I will bring them down.
cases.explain: The transitive verb свергну (I will bring down) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Владыка, Господь сил, касается ___, и она тает.
cases.translation: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts.
cases.explain: The transitive verb касается (touches) here takes the genitive case in the sense of 'of' or 'concerning.'

cases.sentence: Он воздвиг свой величественный дворец на ___, и основание его утвердил на земле.
cases.translation: It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens, and has founded his vault on the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on, in) with the meaning of location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Разве вы, израилетяне, для меня не то же, что и ___?
cases.translation: Are you not like the Ethiopians to me?
cases.explain: The predicate nominative after the verb быть (to be) stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я посадил мой народ на его ___, и никогда впредь он не будет исторгнут.
cases.translation: I have planted them on their land, and they will never be uprooted from it.
cases.explain: The preposition на with the accusative indicates direction or placement on a location.

reading.ru: Я видел владыку, стоящим у жертвенника.
reading.question: Where did Amos see the Lord in this vision?
reading.explain: The text says: 'I saw the Lord standing beside the altar.'

reading.ru: Ни один не укроется, никто не спасется.
reading.question: What does the Lord say about those who try to escape His judgment?
options: None will escape and none will be saved
reading.correct: None will escape and none will be saved
reading.explain: The Lord declares: 'There shall not one of them flee away, and there shall not one of them escape.'

reading.ru: Владыка, Господь сил, касается земли, и она тает.
reading.question: What happens to the land when the Lord touches it?
reading.explain: The text states: 'For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts.'

reading.question: What does the Lord promise to restore?
reading.explain: The Lord says: 'In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen.'

reading.ru: Молодое вино будет сочиться из гор и течь со всех холмов.
reading.question: What will flow from the mountains and hills in the day of restoration?
reading.explain: The text says: 'and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills.'

reading.ru: Они посадят виноградники и будут пить их вино, разведут сады и будут есть их плоды.
reading.question: What will the restored Israel do with their land?
options: Plant vineyards and gardens and enjoy their produce
reading.correct: Plant vineyards and gardens and enjoy their produce
reading.explain: The text states: 'They will plant vineyards, and drink wine from them. They shall also make gardens, and eat their fruit.'
